blocker.summary: Period-specific BLS Employment Situation archives exist, but the strict official archive route is not reproducibly accessible from GitHub Actions; the official FRED/ALFRED Initial Release Only API path requires a FRED_API_KEY that is not configured in the repository.
blocker.why_it_matters: A leakage-free walk-forward backtest must use the unemployment rate as known at each Employment Situation release, not a later revised historical series.

bls_archive_probe.finding: The official period-specific BLS archive probe failed on the first direct anchor, https://www.bls.gov/news.release/archives/empsit_02022018.htm, before parsing could begin.

official_api_alternative.service: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis FRED/ALFRED API
official_api_alternative.note: The credential probe was executed for the same official FRED API service while investigating USD inflation; the missing secret is repository-wide, not series-specific.

prohibited_shortcuts: Do not use current UNRATE history as if it were an as-published first-release ledger.
Do not substitute a different labour-market measure for BLS U-3 unemployment.
Do not use unofficial mirrors or cached copies as canonical release evidence.
Do not infer first-release values from later Employment Situation releases.
reopen_conditions: The official BLS period-specific archive becomes deterministically replayable from the validation runner, or
A FRED_API_KEY is configured and the official Initial Release Only API path is validated against BLS first-release anchors before certification.
